english: Your health's dropping fast! Press E, use your heal pack!
korean: 체력 빠르게 빠지고 있어! E 눌러, 힐팩 써!

english: You're in the red! Heal right now, hit E!
Okay, you're good. Health's back up.
Your shield's down! Get behind cover!
Shield's back online. You're covered.
korean: 보호막 다시 켜졌어. 이제 버틸 수 있어.

english: Your booster fuel is almost empty. Stop boosting!
korean: 부스터 연료 거의 바닥이야. 부스터 그만 써!

english: Fuel's full. You're clear to dash.
You're almost out of ammo. Reload, press R!
korean: 탄약 거의 없어. 재장전해, R 눌러!

english: Your mag's empty! Reload, reload!
Railgun's fully charged. Take the shot!
Your gun's overheating. Ease off the trigger.
Your Q is ready. Use it now!
Q's still on cooldown. Five more seconds.
How's my health? Read it to me.
How much fuel do I have left?
Check my ammo for me.
Where's the objective? You've got my map.
korean: 목표 어디야? 내 지도 너한테 있잖아.

english: Say again? I didn't catch that.
Contact behind you! Turn around!
Incoming from above!
Big one on your radar. It's closing in!
korean: 네 레이더에 큰 놈 있어. 다가오고 있어!

english: Radar's clear. We're safe for now.
Hit the glowing spot. That's its weak point!
Go, go, go! I've got your back.
korean: 가, 가, 가! 뒤는 내가 맡을게.

english: Hold up. Wait for my call.
Stay on me. Don't drift off.
I'm down! Get over here and pick me up!
Hang on, I'm coming to get you.
Thanks. That was close.
Copy that.
Negative. Not yet.
Nice shot!
My bad. That one's on me.
